title: feat(scenarios): run-scenarios --model / --author-model / --ask-model, with the served model recorded per turn
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJdp59LSRHc3ZMoadGaTvT9)_

Fixes #31160

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景跑批器 `run-scenarios` 新增 `--model`(每一轮都用)、`--author-model`(建造/迭代轮)、`--ask-model`(人设问答与操作轮),原样作为 `claude --model` 传给本地 Claude Code。每一轮在运行记录里同时写明「要的模型」和「实际服务的模型」(读自流的 init 行),计分卡的作者行写出实际模型,新增 `Run · model` 行按实际模型统计人设轮次,不一致处标 `⚠`。
- 为什么改:2026-11-06/07 的所有轮次都跑在登录默认模型上,无法固定或对比模型;维护者同意此建议并立卡。
- 风险与回滚:只动私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios`,不发布任何东西;不传新参数时命令行与之前逐字节相同。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts`(按轮次类型传 `--model`、`servedAsRequested` 判不一致)、`src/runner/scorecard.ts`(`Run · model` 行与作者行)、`src/runner/cli.ts`(三个参数、回放拒收)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/units.test.ts test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t model`,预期全部通过(含参数到达 CLI 参数表、记录带实际模型、不一致被标出)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Three flags on `run-scenarios`** (`runner/cli.ts`): `--model M` for every live turn, `--author-model M` for the authoring turns (build and iterate) and `--ask-model M` for the question and operation turns, each of the last two in place of `--model`. A value is an alias (`sonnet`) or a name (`claude-sonnet-4-5`), passed through as `claude --model` takes it; an empty value or one that starts with `-` (a forgotten value swallowing the next flag) is refused. With none, no turn passes `--model` and the login's default serves, as today.
- **Threaded to the driver** (`runner/driver.ts`): `ClaudeCodeDriver` already took `model`; it now also takes `authorModel` / `askModel` and passes the one for the kind of turn. `DriverInfo` states `authorModel` / `askModel`, so the record's `env.driver` and the run's first console line say what was asked for. `RecordedDriver` refuses the three model flags as it refuses the live-driver limits (`makeDriver`): a replay re-reads each turn as it was recorded.
- **The model asked for, beside the model served, per turn**: the live driver stamps each turn's `meta.process.requestedModel` (the `--model` it was given; `runner/transcript.ts`), next to the stream's own `meta.model` it already parsed. The turn summary in the record (`TurnSummary`, `runner/orchestrate.ts`) carries `model` (served), `requestedModel` and `modelMismatch: true` when the served name is not the requested one. A recording keeps both on every turn, so a replay re-reads them as the run saw them.
- **Mismatch rule** (`servedAsRequested`, `runner/driver.ts`): the CLI takes an alias and the stream names the model it resolved to, so a turn is served as asked when the served name holds the requested one as a whole run of its dash-separated parts (`sonnet` and `claude-sonnet-4-5` in `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`; never `opus`, never a fragment like `son`); a context-size suffix (`[1m]`) is dropped. Any other answer, including an alias that names no model family (`default`, `opusplan`), is shown as a mismatch beside both names, for the reader to judge.
- **The scorecard** (`runner/scorecard.ts`): the author rows end with the served model (`success · 17/80 turns · 3m 02s · claude-opus-5-5`, `⚠ asked for sonnet` on a mismatch, `model not reported (asked for sonnet)` when the stream named none); new rows `Run · model` and `Iterate · Run · model` count the half's question and operation turns per served model (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 ×12, claude-opus-5-5 ×2 ⚠ 2 not sonnet`); `—` when no turn named a model and none was asked for. `HalfScores.models` (`ModelTally`) carries the same in the record's `scorecard`.
- README: the two command lines and a **Model** paragraph.

## Why

The card's three asks, verbatim: "`--model ALIAS` for every turn, plus optional `--author-model` / `--ask-model` to set the build and persona turns apart. Thread them to the driver."; "The run record and the scorecard state the model actually served per turn. The stream's `meta.model` is already parsed; show any mismatch with the requested model."; "Tests: the flag reaches the CLI argument list; the record carries the served model." Every recorded turn of the 2026-11-06/07 runs used the login's default model and nothing let a run pin or compare one.

## Tests

- **The flag reaches the CLI's argument list** (`test/runner/units.test.ts`, the stand-in `claude` block, 2 new cases). The stand-in now serves a model the way the real CLI's init line names it (`--model X` → `claude-X-4-5-20250929`; `retired` falls back to `claude-opus-5-5`). Pins: `parseArgs(['--model', 'sonnet'])` → `makeDriver` → both an authoring and an ask turn's argv carry `--model sonnet`, each turn's `meta.process.requestedModel` is `sonnet` and `meta.model` is the served `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`; `--author-model opus --ask-model haiku` beside `--model sonnet` splits them; `--author-model` alone leaves the ask turn with no `--model` and nothing requested; no flag passes no `--model`; a fallback keeps both names. Negative pins: a missing, empty, blank or flag-shaped value is refused per flag; a replay refuses `--model`, and names `--author-model, --ask-model` together.
- **The mismatch rule** (`units.test.ts`, new describe, a 12-row table): alias, name, dated name, case, `[1m]` suffix, other family, wrong version, a fragment of a part, `default`, empty.
- **The record carries the served model** (`test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, new describe, 2 cases): the real crm card through `runCard`, its driver wrapped in a `RecordingDriver` and a stamp that asks for `opus` on authoring turns and `sonnet` on persona turns, with one question's turns served `claude-opus-5-5`. Pins: every turn summary carries `model` and `requestedModel`, exactly that question's turns carry `modelMismatch`; `first.models` counts the served models; the rendered table's author row names `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` and both `Run · model` rows show `⚠ N not sonnet`; the written record (`JSON` round trip) holds `env.driver.authorModel/askModel`, the mismatched turn and the tally; the saved recording replayed through `RecordedDriver.fromFile` (the `--driver recorded:F` path) answers that turn with both names. A run whose turns name no model and ask for none keeps `| Run · model | — |` and the author rows unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

All four run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1) on head `4798cbf1`; the suites import `src/` directly, so no dist leg.

- Ablation 1, the mismatch marking disarmed (`&& !servedAsRequested(…)` in `orchestrate.ts` `summarize` replaced by an always-false `String("ABL1").length < 0`): `orchestrate.test.ts -t served` → `1 failed | 2 passed` (the served-model record case).
- Ablation 2, the replay refusal of the model flags disarmed (`LIVE_FLAGS.filter` → `LIVE_FLAGS.slice(0, 3 + …).filter` in `cli.ts`): `units.test.ts -t model` → `1 failed | 6 passed` (the refusal case).
- Ablation 3, the empty / flag-shaped value refusal disarmed (`raw.trim() === '' || raw.startsWith('-')` → `raw === String("ABL3")`): `units.test.ts -t model` → `1 failed | 6 passed` (the refusal case).
- Ablation 4, the `--model` threading disarmed (`if (model) a.push` → `if (model && String("ABL4").length < 0) a.push` in `driver.ts` `base`): `units.test.ts -t model` → `1 failed | 6 passed` (the argument-list case).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Served is read off the stream, never inferred from the request.** A turn whose stream named no model (no init line: a spawn that failed) shows `model not reported`, and is never counted as a mismatch: nothing was served to compare.
- **No model allow-list.** The runner does not validate an alias against a list: `claude` answers an unknown model itself, and that turn is recorded as it failed. A list here would go stale with every model release.
- **Recordings made before this change** carry no `requestedModel`; their turns show the served model and no mismatch.
- **Serial with PR #31188** (`--packages`, same `cli.ts` / `scorecard.ts`): it was still open when this PR opened, so `origin/main` was merged once before it; the seat's order has this branch merge `origin/main` again after #31188 lands. #31159 (`--driver external`) follows on the same files; this change stays local to the flags, the driver options and the record.
- `@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` and nothing else moved: `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

**Current head `45ceeaff`** (second `origin/main` merge, at `065bba72`, carrying #31188; plain merge, no rebase). The only conflict was the README command block, and all three new lines were kept. Inside the merge, the new `orchestrate.test.ts` `runRecord` call passes `packages: PUBLISHED` because #31188 made `RunRecordMeta.packages` required. On this head: 25 files / 516 tests pass, typecheck and scoped eslint exit 0, and `dispatch-gates --ran` shows 49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` now measured). Ablations were not rerun because the merge touched none of the ablated lines. The rounds below are on the earlier head.

All on head `0b43e745` (the final commit: the work at `4798cbf1` plus one merge of `origin/main` at `8acbfab9`), in worktree `objectstack-issue-31160`, base `620b6e6d`. `origin/main` has since moved (#31185 among others, which touches `packages/qa/scenarios` prompts and tests); `git merge-tree` against it is clean.

- Package suite, under the verify lock after `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/scenarios..." build` on the merged head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` → `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 460 passed (460)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, test files included: `--listFiles` lists `test/runner/units.test.ts`) exit 0; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Lint scoped to the package: `eslint packages/qa/scenarios --no-inline-config` exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 49 commands, all run on this head; 48 `exit 0`; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist/`, and only the scenarios closure was built here) — NOT MEASURED, left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: `49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Changeset: none. The diff touches only the private `@objectstack/scenarios` (`"private": true`): `skip-changeset`.
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
- No live model run (paused by the maintainer): the flag-to-argv path is measured against a stand-in `claude`, and the replay path through `RecordedDriver.fromFile` on a recording the test writes.
